s.how: Simmer 500g raw peanuts in the shell for 2 hours in water with 80g salt and 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning. Turn off the heat and soak an hour. Drain and serve warm in paper cups.

s.note: a Texas sheriff a long way from home
s.how: Pack 400g okra into a jar with 3 garlic cloves, dill and a chilli. Pour over 300ml hot white vinegar boiled with 200ml water and 1 tbsp salt. Pickle a week. Serve cold with 200g sharp cheddar.

m.note: a quick stop while the Snowman keeps rolling
m.how: Pound 4 minute steaks thin. Dredge in seasoned flour, then buttermilk, then flour again and fry until crisp. Whisk 2 tbsp flour into the pan fat, add 400ml milk and lots of cracked pepper and simmer. Serve over mash.

w.how: Toss 6 sliced peaches with 80g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and lemon juice. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop over the fruit. Bake at 190C for 40 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: the long haul from Texarkana to Atlanta
d.how: Brew 5 black tea bags in 1L boiling water with 2 sliced peaches and 100g sugar for 6 minutes. Remove the bags and chill with the peaches in. Fill four tall glasses with ice, add 30ml bourbon to each, then top with the tea. Finish each with a squeeze of lemon, a peach slice and a sprig of mint.
